errors.description: Set consistency: the three collar-stand siblings were shot on different cloth and different underlayers (notch = charcoal over bare skin, peak = navy over a navy shirt, shawl = navy over bare skin) despite a MATCHED SET LOCK in each prompt. This one is the shawl member.
errors.expected: identical cloth, underlayer, subject distance and framing across notch/peak/shawl
errors.correction: On any re-shoot, fix one cloth and one underlayer across all three members.

notes: Shawl reads correctly: one continuous unbroken rolled edge from the neck band down to the button, with no notch, no peak and no gorge seam anywhere along the run, and narrower at the neck than the siblings as drawn.
